---
title: "Luise Jacobsen completes her PhD"
date: 2025-09-12
description: "Luise defended her thesis on mechanisms of the mitochondrial uncoupling protein UCP1."
categories: [Group]
---

Luise Jacobsen defended her PhD thesis on **Investigating Uncoupling Protein 1 Mechanisms Using Molecular Dynamics Simulations**, continuing the group's work on proton transport and mitochondrial membrane proteins.

[PhyLife announcement](https://www.sdu.dk/en/forskning/phylife/news-and-events)
